title: Post rollout auto-rollback events to Slack (concise notification + links)
author: Rafael Mendes
body: Summary: incident-bot now posts a Slack notification when the rollout controller triggers an automatic safety action due to an SLO breach (auto_rollback, auto_pause, or rollback_suppressed). The message is intentionally short, includes the rollout_id and scope, and provides deep links to (1) the rollout in Console, (2) the rollout SLO dashboard, and (3) the audit event details. Motivation: during the 2026-02 simulations and recent customer escalations, oncall often learned about auto-mitigations only after secondary alerts or customer reports; this closes the loop and reduces time-to-context while keeping noise bounded. Event source: consumes the new structured audit event emitted to the event stream (redwood PR-28435) with event_type=rollout.auto_action.*. The handler maps event subtypes to Slack severity and routing without paging by default (notify-only) to avoid paging storms. Message format (example): "[AUTO-ROLLBACK] rollout=rol_01HT… scope=route:/v1/chat model=llama3.1-70b-v3 region=us-east tier=dedicated reason=p99_latency_burnrate_fast" followed by links: Console rollout, Grafana dashboard, Audit event (internal). Guardrails: (a) dedupe by (rollout_id, action, step_id) for 10 minutes, (b) drop messages if required links can’t be constructed (still increments a metric), (c) redacts customer identifiers (uses customer_tier + optional org_id hash only), (d) rate limits per channel to 1 msg/sec with burst=5. Routing: auto_rollback -> #eng-oncall (notify) + #eng-sre (notify); auto_pause -> #eng-platform (notify); rollback_suppressed -> thread reply on the most recent auto action message if present, otherwise #eng-sre (notify). Configuration: adds rollout_auto_actions.enabled (default false in prod; true in staging), rollout_auto_actions.channels overrides, and a link template block for Console/Grafana base URLs per environment. Observability: emits incident_bot_slack_posts_total{type=rollout_auto_action,outcome=sent|dropped|rate_limited|deduped} and incident_bot_rollout_auto_action_events_total{action=rollback|pause|suppressed}. Testing: unit tests cover payload parsing, formatting, dedupe, and redaction; an integration test uses a fixture event to validate generated Slack blocks; updated run instructions in README. Rollout plan: staging enablement first (paired with redwood PR-28490), then prod behind flag once dashboards/alerts are confirmed (observability-pack PR-913).
commits: Add rollout auto action event handler + Slack formatter
Implement dedupe cache + per-channel rate limiting
Add config schema + env defaults (staging on, prod off)
Unit + integration tests for rollout event notifications
Docs: README update for local testing + troubleshooting
checks: CI: build (pass), unit tests (pass), lint (pass), integration tests (pass). Note: initial run failed due to a flaky timing assertion in dedupe TTL test; fixed by injecting clock and reran successfully.
conversation: Sean Gallagher: Can we ensure this doesn’t page? We got burned by incident-bot integrations turning into paging storms. Author (Rafael): Confirmed notify-only; no PagerDuty integration. Also added dedupe + per-channel rate limiting and made prod default disabled behind rollout_auto_actions.enabled. Aisha Bello: Please include Grafana links to the rollout SLO view and the ‘auto-rollback triggered’ panel so oncall can jump directly to context. Rafael: Added dashboard link template with route/model/region variables and verified in staging; falls back to generic dashboard if scope is missing. Felix Schneider: Any privacy issues with including org/customer names? We should avoid posting customer identifiers in shared channels. Rafael: Redacted org_name; only includes customer_tier and (optional) hashed org_id. Added tests to ensure no raw org_name fields leak. Logan Wright: Ensure the bot increments a metric when dropping due to missing links; otherwise we’ll silently lose notifications. Rafael: Added incident_bot_slack_posts_total{outcome=dropped,drop_reason=missing_link_template|invalid_payload}. Approvals after requested changes.
release_notes: incident-bot can now post concise Slack notifications for rollout auto actions (rollback/pause/suppressed) with deep links to Console + Grafana.
Feature is behind rollout_auto_actions.enabled (prod default: false; staging default: true).
